title: ILoveKebab
description: A fun resource pack that replaces in‑game food and UI elements with kebab‑themed textures for a lighthearted, tasty twist on Minecraft.
body: This is a fun and lighthearted resource pack that replaces various in‑game textures with kebab‑themed designs. It gives Minecraft a tasty twist by adding food‑inspired visuals while keeping the game’s original style intact. More textures are being added over time, so the pack will continue to grow with new kebab‑themed items and UI elements.
